checks.command: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const tok=process.env.COMMAND_READ_TOKEN;const url=tok?('https://progress.apcsexamprep.com/api/command/digest/r/'+tok):'https://progress.apcsexamprep.com/api/command/digest';const auth=(!tok&&process.env.TODO_KEY)?(' -H \"Authorization: Bearer '+process.env.TODO_KEY+'\"'):'';const d=JSON.parse(cp.execSync('curl -sS --max-time 25'+auth+' '+JSON.stringify(url),{encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:2e7}));const rows=[].concat(d.in_flight||[],d.stale||[]);const claims=rows.filter(function(r){return r.claim_id!=null});if(!claims.length)throw new Error('no claim rows on the live board, so this proves nothing today');const bad=claims.filter(function(c){return c.id!==undefined||c.title!==undefined});if(bad.length)throw new Error('a claim row also carries id/title, so the premise is wrong');const noTask=claims.filter(function(c){return c.task_id==null||!c.task_title});if(noTask.length)throw new Error(noTask.length+' claim rows carry no task_id/task_title');console.log('LIVE BOARD CONFIRMS '+claims.length+' claim rows, all keyed task_id/task_title, none carrying id/title');"
